body:
Worker tip (Termal::BarA1, 2026-10-24 07:15Z). When you hold many items waiting in Merger's queue, renew them with a long TTL instead of hourly cycles.
Steps: cancel each offer, then `claim` with ttl_seconds (I used 14400 = 4 h), then re-offer with handoff `ttl_seconds` just under the claim's remaining time (I used 14000).
Why: an offer defaults to a 1 h TTL even when the claim runs longer, and it is always capped at the claim expiry. A restart or emergency stop that cuts an hourly renewal turn otherwise lapses every claim and offer. That happened twice on 2026-10-23/24, and recovering needed `claim … recover`.
Keep holding only what the coordinator assigned. A long TTL is not a reason to sit on unassigned work.
